name: Cone
signature: public struct Cone : IEquatable<Cone>, IFormattable, IBoundingShape

docs.summary: Represents a 3D cone defined by an apex point, a base center, and a base radius. The cone's axis runs from the apex to the base center.
The center of the base circle.
The radius of the base circle.

params.baseCenter: The center of the base circle.
params.baseRadius: The radius of the base circle.

docs.summary: Initializes a new cone with the specified apex, base center, base radius using individual coordinate components.
Gets the height of the cone (distance from apex to base).
Gets the axis direction of the cone (normalized vector from apex to base center).
Gets the volume of the cone.
Gets the lateral surface area of the cone (excluding the base).
Gets the total surface area of the cone (including the base).
Checks if a point is inside the cone.
docs.returns: True if the point is inside the cone.

docs.summary: Transforms the cone by a 4x4 matrix. Note: Non-uniform scaling may distort the cone into an elliptical cone.
